answer.book: Printed Latin volume (Zurich, Froschauer, 1563) holding several works: Josias Simler's funeral oration on Peter Martyr Vermigli, with dedications and preface, followed by Vermigli's Eucharist writings, then verse tributes (carmina, epigrams, epitaphs) and letters, some in Greek.
